items.headline: Carrick happy with transfer business; squad depth improved
items.summary: Michael Carrick says Manchester United squad has improved despite lower net spend than promoted clubs, citing signings of Santos, Tielemans, Baleba and Darlow.

items.headline: Five players ruled out for Everton fixture with injury concerns mounting
items.summary: Manchester United missing Matthijs de Ligt, Amad Diallo, Carlos Baleba, Tom Heaton and Manuel Ugarte for Sunday's trip to Everton.

items.headline: Carrick expects tough Everton test despite Moyes' transfer disappointment
items.summary: United boss Carrick says Everton always a tough trip, noting Red Devils have better depth than Moyes who lost Ndiaye and Beto on deadline day.

items.headline: Zirkzee stays at Old Trafford despite exit links; Carrick backs Dutchman
items.summary: Joshua Zirkzee remained at Manchester United after speculation linking him to Juventus and Fiorentina; Carrick expects him to play more.

items.headline: Bradbury seals Stoke departure after academy exit
items.summary: Youth striker Louie Bradbury has left Manchester United to sign with Stoke City.

items.headline: Biancheri joins FC Wacker Innsbruck on loan
items.summary: Manchester United academy player joins Austrian club on loan deal.
